name: Bond County, IL
findings: Bond County has 72 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bond County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Bond County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
